summary: The paper presents a definitive, mathematically rigorous, and fully machine-checked resolution of foundational open problems in the resource theory of quantum-state texture (QST) across arbitrary finite dimensions D >= 2. Building on filter-and-preparation SDPs and scalar resolvent characterizations, the author establishes: (1) Quadratic-ball Fenchel-Moreau duality and spectral-measure free equivalence, unifying previous criteria and refuting de Leon's Eq. (64); (2) A sharp dimensional jump proving dim_ord = infinity for D >= 3 via explicit full-rank rational families and a no-go theorem for finite monotone sets; (3) Multiplicative tensor convolution, Petz Renyi Mellin monotones, and explicit rational witnesses demonstrating simultaneous qubit-catalytic and 2-copy super-activation in D >= 3 alongside sharp D = 2 no-activation; (4) Complete GKSL normal form, exact sum-of-squares resolvent dissipation, and a sharp Markovian rank-non-decrease barrier proving that complete reset and measure-and-prepare channels are strictly non-Markovian. All analytic proofs are substantiated by 20 machine-checked Lean 4 theorems (zero sorry, zero warnings) and 16 AST-audited exact Q/Q[i] certificates.
strengths: Complete resolution of major open problems in quantum-state texture across all finite dimensions D >= 2 and D >= 3.
